Market demand and prices changed,
people east less meat, more vegetables,
XX is popular with tourists who want salads along with shahlik (meat dish).
Not much, only men are expected to carry heavy things around
and women are best in routine activities like taking care of household plot.
There are cases when women become successful farmers with up to 50 ha of land and grow cotton and wheat.
Farming is mechanized now a lot
and gender is not a problem in farming, hard work and innovation are better factors for successful farming.
Young women are expected not to be out of house except for work or study.
Young women successfully grow vegetables along with mothers, but selling is done by mothers or fathers,
it is not good for young women to sell anything in public places.
Sellers should bring products to markets in early morning and young women are not allowed to leave house non daytime.
Young women are not expect to earn money, they can help with household duties only.
Vegetables are considered to be products grown by women.
If young men want to grow vegetables, they do not face any difficulties, quality and quantity are more important.
Wife is expected to farm household plot, husband can rent a plot in farmland.
Children mainly help wife with household plot and can help father with harvesting farmland plot.
Poultry is mainly women domain,
livestock care except milking is men’s.
As the plot is general, wife and husband work together

On farm plots – mainly in seedling planting and harvesting.
Woman would first consult with husband, as cultivation of rented land will require her to be outside house often and it is religiously mandatory to get permission from husband.
Usually husband will require her not to sacrifice household duties if she wants to cultivate summer crops (these crops are not controlled by the state and are considered cash crops) in rented plot.

For man it is easier to start cultivating summer crops on rented plots by informing family members on his decision and need for their help with seedling planting and harvest and maybe additional help.
Man might have difficulties with finding money to buy seedlings and fertilizers for greater sized rented plot compared to household plot area.
If joining the local group will not take too much time from her household duties – it is OK.

nd sometimes it is easier for husband to arrange for necessary goods by himself.

if her family is OK for them, they can visit her family for marriage discussion.
